filesystem.note: APFS supports both hard links and copy-on-write file clones. st_blocks reports each clone at full size, so allocated bytes cannot see copy-on-write sharing; the free-space-delta experiments record the true incremental cost.

tool_versions.pnpm: 10.15.1 (pinned via worker/package.json packageManager, resolved through corepack)
tool_versions.pnpm_on_path: 11.24.0 (not used; the install script pins the version)
tool_versions.du: BSD du (macOS); -A reports apparent size, default reports allocated blocks

conditions.cold_definition: cold = no pre-existing content-addressed store objects and no pre-existing local Git objects for the measured source. The operating-system page cache is deliberately not purged, because purging is a whole-machine operation on a shared host; cold and warm therefore describe tool-level caches only and are never blended in a single row.
conditions.warm_definition: warm = a populated shared dependency store, installed with the network disabled (--offline) so a warm row can never silently include a network fetch.
